text: Anika's driving test is on 14 November. Remind me to text her good luck the evening before, and to ask how it went the next day.
Dawit is vegan now, properly vegan, not just at home. He also can't stand mushrooms, so no risotto when he comes over.
Chantal mentioned she's been knitting a blanket for her sister Petra's baby, due early December. She's using a really soft merino and is about halfway through.
Jonah supports Leeds United and has a season ticket. He said the last home game was so bad he almost left at half time.
Duc and his wife are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 3rd of March. They're thinking about going back to Hanoi for it.
Need to book the boiler service before the cold weather sets in. Ideally a weekday morning.
Rohan's interview at the council is Thursday. He's really nervous about the presentation part. I should call him that morning, then again afterwards to see how he got on.

Farah is allergic to tree nuts, including almonds, so check the cake ingredients before her party on 22/11. She's turning forty and wants a quiet one, just dinner at home with her sisters and a few friends. She mentioned she's been getting into watercolours and keeps eyeing a travel paint set, which would make a lovely present.
Abebe has started running with a club on Tuesday nights and is training for the Brighton half marathon in April. He wants to get under two hours.
Georgia's dad has his knee operation on 8th of December. She's taking the week after off to look after him. Don't forget to check in with her a few days after.
Anan collects vinyl, mostly old Thai funk and soul records. He said he's always hunting for anything on the Lam Pradab label.
Aurelio only drinks his coffee black, no sugar. Also likes a negroni if we go out.

Thomas told me the wedding is off. He and Kate split up in September and he's moved back to his mum's for now. He seemed okay but tired, and said he's been throwing himself into five a side and cycling to keep busy. He's also off drinking for a while. I should take him out for a curry soon, somewhere that does a good vindaloo, he loves the hot stuff.
Sinead plays the fiddle in a trad session at the Cobblestone every Wednesday. She asked if I wanted to come along one week.
Henrik's gig with the jazz quartet is on the 30th. I'm going with Francesca. Remind me to buy tickets the week before because they sold out last time.
Yetunde is gluten free, coeliac actually, and very strict about cross contamination. Her husband Femi eats anything.
Niamh starts her new job at the hospital pharmacy on 1st of February. She's excited but worried about the night shifts.
Called Shanice about the book club. She's picked a Toni Morrison for November and wants everyone to have read at least half by the 12th.
Sam's cat Biscuit went missing on Sunday. He's put posters up all round the estate. I should message him tomorrow to see if there's any news.
Valentina has finally finished the quilt she's been working on for two years. She's entering it in the county show next summer.
Dana and her partner are moving to Bristol at the end of January. Their kids start at the new school after half term.
Dalia hates coriander with a passion. Also doesn't eat pork. Keep that in mind for the dinner on 6 December.

Karan said his brother Archie is getting married in Goa on 18th of February. Karan is best man and has to give a speech, which he's dreading. The stag is in Lisbon on 24th of January. Karan is a nervous public speaker and asked if I'd read a draft. Remind me to ask for the draft the week before the stag, and to text him good luck the morning of the wedding.

Nikolai plays chess online most evenings and is around 1900 on Lichess. He'd love a proper wooden board, which might be a good birthday idea. His birthday is 9th of March. He also mentioned he's teaching his nephew to play on Saturdays, and that he's been reading a biography of Tal. Doesn't drink, but loves really strong black tea.
Sana's exam results come out on 15 August. Remind me to message her that afternoon.

Ibrahim is doing Ramadan this year for the first time since he was a kid. He's finding the afternoons really hard at work. His team keeps scheduling lunch meetings, which doesn't help. He said Eid is on the 20th and his family always does a huge spread at his aunt's. He loves dates stuffed with almonds, so maybe bring a box when I see him the week after.
Met Petra Schmidt for lunch. She's head of design at a small agency in Shoreditch now and absolutely loves it. Drinks oat flat whites, nothing else.
Femi's mum turns seventy on 2nd of January. They're throwing a big party at a hall in Peckham. He asked if I could help with the music.
Chantal's grandma passed away last week. The funeral is on Friday. I should send a card before then and call Chantal the weekend after.
Picking up the new glasses on Saturday morning, then the car's MOT at two.
Jonah mentioned his daughter has her first ballet recital on 5th of December. He said she's been practising in the kitchen every night.
Anika is really into bouldering at the moment and goes three times a week. She also mentioned a trip to Fontainebleau in the spring with her climbing friends.
Rohan got the job! He starts on 6 January. Must send him something to celebrate, maybe a nice bottle of single malt since he loves Islay whiskies.
Duc is lactose intolerant but will happily eat cheese if it's hard and aged. Odd, but noted.
Georgia's cooking course runs every Monday until 15 December. She said the Thai curry week was the best so far, and she keeps talking about getting a proper wok.
Abebe and Kate have a dinner party on the 9th. I'm bringing dessert. Kate is vegetarian and Abebe doesn't like anything too sweet.
Sinead's son Archie has his grade 5 piano exam on 27/11. She's more nervous than he is. Remind me to ask her how he did the day after.
Spent ages on the phone with Aurelio. He's struggling since the redundancy and hasn't been sleeping. I need to invite him round for dinner next week and properly check how he's doing.
Henrik is a huge Arsenal fan, the kind who knows every squad number. His birthday is on 11th of April and he'd love the new away shirt.
Francesca told me she's pregnant, due in May. She's had awful morning sickness so far and has gone off coffee completely.
Note for Saturday: Thomas is bringing his dog Pepper to the barbecue, so keep the gate shut.
Yetunde's daughter graduates from Leeds on 19th of July. The whole family is going up for the ceremony and staying the night.
Niamh has got really into making sourdough. She's named her starter Gerald and feeds it every morning before work.
Shanice was cagey about the date, but her surgery is sometime in the first week of December. Don't forget to send flowers the day after, and maybe drop round with soup the week after that.
Sam got into the five a side league finals, playing on 23 November at Powerleague. He's captain this season. Text him good luck that morning.
Valentina Reyes runs a tiny pottery studio from her garage. Mostly mugs and bowls with a speckled glaze. She's selling at the Christmas market on 13/12.
Dana's mum has been in hospital since Monday with a chest infection. Dana is exhausted, going back and forth every day. I should text her tonight, and offer to pick the kids up on Wednesday.
Dalia and Ibrahim got engaged over the weekend! The engagement party is on 20th of December at Ibrahim's parents' house in Leicester.
Karan plays Dungeons and Dragons every other Sunday with his uni friends and is the dungeon master. He's been writing his own campaign for months.
Nikolai's flight to Sofia was cancelled, so he's now going on the 2nd instead. He's annoyed because he'll miss his cousin's christening.
Lunch with Sana. She's training to be a nurse and has a placement on a cardiac ward starting 10 November. Prefers tea, not coffee, and is trying to cut out sugar.
Ibrahim's younger brother Anan has his first day at secondary school on 4th of September. Ibrahim is taking him in that morning. Remember to ask Ibrahim how it went that evening.
Femi supports Crystal Palace and plays in a Sunday league team. He also told me about Chantal, his sister, who plays netball for the county.
Archie, or Arch as everyone calls him, is doing Dry January again. He's swapping to alcohol free IPA, which apparently is good now.
Petra's dog Mochi has a vet operation on Tuesday for a lump on her leg. Petra's worried sick. Remind me to call her the day before and then that evening once Mochi is home.

Long catch up with Farah. Her husband Dawit has been offered a promotion to regional manager, starting after Easter, but it means a lot more travel. She's not sure how she feels about it. Their son starts nursery in January too, so it's a lot at once. She's been baking to relax, mostly cinnamon buns and Persian love cake. I should drop round the week after he starts and bring something.
Georgia Wright mentioned her book club is reading Middlemarch, very slowly. She loves Victorian novels and reads mostly on her Kindle in the bath.
Thinking of doing the Parkrun on Saturday, then the big shop afterwards. Need to renew the car insurance before 28/10.

Talked to Kate about her parents' ruby wedding on 14 June. She and her brother Jonah are organising a surprise meal, and she wants ideas for a restaurant that does good vegetarian food because her mum doesn't eat meat. Her dad loves real ale and old Westerns. I offered to look into a few places near Harrogate. Remind me to send her a shortlist by the end of the week, and to ask her the week after the meal how it went.

Duc's father had a minor stroke on 12th of October. He's home now and recovering slowly. Duc is going back to Vietnam for three weeks from 1 November. I need to message Duc before he flies, and again once he's back to see how his dad is doing.
